in_hebrew.name: דני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דני נגזר מהשורש העברי 'דן', שפירושו 'לשפוט' או 'דין'. הוא קשור לאמונה כי האל הוא השופט האמיתי והצודק. השם מופיע בתנ'ך כדן, בנו של יעקב, וגם כדניאל, הנביא שפירש חלומות.

in_greek.name: Ντάνι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντάνι είναι σύντομη μορφή του Δανιήλ (Daniel), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Δανιήλ αναφέρεται ως προφήτης που ερμήνευσε οράματα και ήταν σύμβολο πίστης και σοφίας.

in_latin.name: Dannie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dannie derivatur ex hebraico 'Dan', quod significat 'judicare'. In traditione christiana, nomen istud refertur ad fidem in Deum qui verus et justus judex est. Est forma abbreviata nominis Danielis, prophetae biblici.

in_english.meaning: God is my judge or divine judgment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dannie is derived from the Hebrew root 'Dan', meaning 'to judge'. It is a variant of Daniel, which appears in the Bible as a prophet and interpreter of dreams. The name signifies faith in God as the ultimate judge and arbiter of justice. Historically, it has been used across Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual discernment and righteousness.

biblical_reference.note: The name Dannie is associated with Dan, a son of Jacob, and Daniel, a prophet in the Old Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Daniel or its variations Dan, Don, Danno, or Dannie, have been popular throughout Western history, particularly during the Middle Ages. It was the name of several saints and became a common given name among Christian Europeans. In England, the name was popularized by the legend of St. Dunstan, an eleventh-century bishop who is said to have founded colleges, schools, and churches. In Scotland, the name Dan is linked to the famous MacLaren clan, and in Ireland, it is associated with St. Dympna, the patron saint of mental illness.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Daniel holds immense spiritual significance, representing faith, courage, and devotion to God. Daniel's story in the Bible teaches us to remain steadfast in our beliefs, even when faced with obstacles and challenges. His ability to interpret dreams and visions for kings demonstrates God's power and presence, and his unwavering commitment to prayer and fasting, despite the temptations and distractions of the court, inspires us to prioritize our spiritual lives. The name Daniel serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking God's guidance and wisdom in our own lives, and the power of faith to overcome adversity.
